title: SeaBass Fishing
native_title: シーバス・フィッシング
overview:
Exhilarating fishing at home!!

A full-fledged lure fishing game targeting the sea bass (suzuki in Japanese), a popular fish in saltwater game fishing.

Pick a spot on the coast, choose your lure from the tackle box and cast. Once a fish bites, the fight plays out up close with 3D polygon fish: watch the line tension, the length of line out and the depth as you work your catch in.

- Tournament Mode, plus a Free Fishing Mode where you choose the fish you want to catch and fish as you like
- Real fishing tackle, made in cooperation with Daiwa Seiko
- A Fishing Introduction corner where sea bass lure fishing expert Masami Murakoshi teaches the basics by voice, so beginners can play with confidence

家庭で痛快フィッシング!!

海のゲームフィッシングとして人気の高いシーバス（日本名スズキ）を対象魚とした本格的ルアー・フィッシング・ゲーム
